# COR
> COR is the GTM marketing OS for lean Seed & Series A B2B SaaS teams. Find warm LinkedIn prospects scored against your ICP, track your visibility in AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude), and ship on-brand content — from one connected platform.
## Pricing
- Free Diagnostic — $0, 14-day trial, 200 credits
- Starter — $99/mo, 2,500 credits/month
- Growth — $199/mo, 6,000 credits/month
- Pro — $299/mo, 12,000 credits/month
- Credit packs from $29 (500 credits); packs never expire. Annual billing saves 20%.
## Product
- Core Blueprint — your ICP, messaging, positioning and competitors, stored once and used by every module
- Prospect Scout — turns LinkedIn signals into ICP-scored prospect lists with outbound copy ready to send
- AI Presence — tracks whether AI chatbots mention you across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude, and shows gaps to close
- Content Studio — generates content in your voice, informed by your Blueprint
